title: acorn: add a maxNestingDepth option (options, state, tokenizer)
prompt: This is a copy of the acorn JavaScript parser (acorn/src). Add a parser option `maxNestingDepth` (default `null`, meaning unlimited, and present in `defaultOptions`). The nesting depth at any moment is the number of currently open `(`, `[`, `{` and template-literal `${` tokens that have not yet been closed. When consuming an opening token would make the depth exceed `maxNestingDepth`, raise a SyntaxError (through the normal `raise` so it carries `pos` and `loc`) at the start of that opening token with the message `Maximum nesting depth of N exceeded`, where N is the configured limit. Code that stays within the limit, and all code when the option is not set, must parse exactly as before.
